quotes.text: Procurement and sourcing might sound like a long name for buying things, and it is about buying, but the two words describe different jobs. Sourcing is the work of finding and choosing the right vendor.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: A purchase requisition is an internal request to buy something. It tells the company what a person needs, how much, and often where it should go. Notice that this request doesn't promise anything to a vendor yet.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Plain definition of the first record in the purchasing process.

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 compares three things, what the company ordered, what the company received, and what the vendor billed. People call this matching. Plain English, does the bill match the deal?
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains invoice matching in one memorable question.

quotes.text: A low price on paper may not look so attractive if the vendor repeatedly delivers late, ships incomplete orders or cannot meet the agreed terms.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Argues for vendor performance over price alone.

quotes.text: Sourcing helps the company choose who to buy from while procurement manages what happens after the company decides to buy.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A one-sentence summary of the whole episode.

takeaways: Sourcing chooses the right vendor, while procurement manages the request, approval, purchase order, receipt, invoice and payment in one source-to-pay process.
In Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management a purchase starts as a requisition, can go through an RFQ and becomes a purchase order backed by vendor records, agreements and approval workflows.

Product receipts and three-way matching against the purchase order and invoice catch differences before payment, and the connected record enables spend analysis, vendor evaluation and a full audit trail.
hook: Purchasing often runs through emails, spreadsheets and paper delivery notes, so nobody can say who approved a purchase or whether an invoice is right. This episode explains for beginners how Dynamics 365 Procurement and Sourcing connects requests, vendors, purchase orders, receipts, invoice matching and payment into one traceable process.
